About.title: About me
About.eyebrow: Three years of daily practice with data and automation
About.lead: My strength is not a single tool but structured work with data: maintain, verify, automate and check the result.
paragraphs: My path began with a clear signal: after my degree in Economic Cybernetics (bachelor level recognised by the German ZAB), I took 1st place among around 6,000 participants in the RS School / EPAM JS/FE Pre-School course in 2022.

Since then I have spent about three years working daily on web and data automation — AI-assisted: I define the workflows, implement them, verify the results and systematically look for root causes when something is off.

Today I focus that experience on data maintenance and digitalisation: keeping records clean and current, finding inconsistencies before anyone notices them, and replacing the same manual steps with verifiable automation.

About.motivationTitle: What a team gets from me
motivationPoints: I handle recurring maintenance carefully and do not complain about routine.
I spot which steps can be automated and implement that without turning it into a big project.
I do not treat AI as a black box: results are tested, questioned and improved.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: The core project is mono-api-agent — a RAG agent over an official OpenAPI specification. Alongside it: my own E2E test suite and several live demos on this site.

items.title: mono-api-agent
items.summary: RAG agent over monobank's official OpenAPI specification: chunking per method, hybrid retrieval and a deterministic hallucination check instead of an LLM judge.

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.intro: My path is hands-on: a completed degree, a strong course result and about three years of daily work on real automation and data tasks.

timeline.title: BSc Economic Cybernetics (distance learning, Kyiv)
timeline.text: A combination of business and IT subjects. Assessed by the German ZAB as equivalent to German bachelor level (03/2025).

timeline.title: JS/FE Pre-School — RS School / EPAM
timeline.text: Intensive course on JavaScript and frontend fundamentals with weekly assignments and peer review.

timeline.title: Daily practice in web and data automation
timeline.text: More than 20 own projects and over 100 scripts and workflows: recurring data maintenance, research and content transfer automated instead of manual — running reliably for months. Plus a public Playwright E2E suite with GitHub Actions CI against this website.

Resume.closingTitle: What a team can expect from me
Resume.closingText: I work carefully even when a task repeats, and I am open about where I currently stand. What I cannot do yet I learn quickly — what I can do is backed by public code.
